title: Greek, Module 1
lessonThemes: Arriving at a café in Thessaloniki: greeting the waiter and asking for a coffee
Ordering more: water, a coffee for a friend, yes and no, how much it costs
Meeting someone at the next table: names, nice to meet you
Where are you from? Cities and countries, I live in…
Numbers one to five while paying at a kiosk (periptero)
At the bakery: I want, bread, a koulouri, one or two
Times of day: good morning, good evening, how are you, so-so
Asking the way: where is the hotel, the bus stop, the square
Directions: left, right, straight on, near, far
Review lesson: a full morning in the city, mixing everything so far
Taking the bus: a ticket, to the centre, which stop
Time: what time is it, now, later, today, tomorrow
Numbers six to ten, giving a phone number
At the market: fruit, a kilo of, this one, that one, how much
Likes and dislikes: I like, I don't like, very much
At a taverna: a table for two, the menu, the bill please
Food and drink: fish, salad, wine, beer, something sweet
Learning the language: do you speak, slowly please, say it again, I don't understand
Family and friends: my wife, my husband, children, a friend
Review lesson: an evening at a taverna with new friends
At the hotel: a room, the key, for three nights, breakfast
Days of the week and making plans
Weather: hot, cold, sun, rain, the sea
A day trip: the boat, the island, let's go, at what time
Shopping: big, small, a colour, too expensive, I'll take it
Feeling unwell: I am tired, my head hurts, the pharmacy
Invitations: do you want to, together, tonight, with pleasure
Talking about tomorrow: I will go, I want to see, I have to
On the phone: call me, my number, later, see you
Grand review: a whole day in Thessaloniki from breakfast to goodnight
notes: Original curriculum. Situations come from everyday travel, not from any existing course. Humans may edit themes before the plan is written.
